properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 1049877 - Medium Affected: OTHER - Suspected Responsible Party: SEARS AUTOMOTIVE CENTER
properties.content:
Report Details

Location: SEARS AUTOMOTIVE CENTER 100 SPOTSYLVANIA MALL
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: UNKNOWN OIL
Medium Affected: OTHER
Suspected Responsible Party: SEARS AUTOMOTIVE CENTER
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 38.307633, -77.578393 (Approximated from ZIP)
Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** THE AUTOMOTIVE CENTER PUTS CHEMICALS IN THEIR MOP BUCKETS AND WIPES THEIR FLOOR CLEAN WITH THE MOP. THE FLOOR INCLUDES OIL, TRANSMISSION FLUID, AND OTHER MISC CAR FLUIDS. THEY THEN DUMP THIS OUT INTO THE PARKING LOT DAILY WHICH RUNS INTO A PARKING LOT DRAIN WHICH HAS BEEN MARKED AS A DRAIN LEADING TO THE BAY (DRAIN WITH THE BLUE CRAB SYMBOL). THEY APPROXIMATELY HAVE A 12 CAR BAY, WHICH IS CLEANED THROUGHOUT THE DAY AND THE BUCKET AS WELL AS MOP IS RINSED OFF OUTSIDE. THIS LOCATION IN PARTICULAR HAS A DRAIN SYSTEM INSIDE THE BAY ON THE FLOORS THAT IS FILTERED, AND DRAINED BY A COMPANY FOR HAZARDOUS MATERIAL. HOWEVER THEY DO NOT USE THIS DRAIN BUT RATHER DUMP IT OUTSIDE. IF YOU WERE TO LOOK AT THE "EXIT BAY" WHERE THE CARS LEAVE THE CENTER, YOU WILL SEE THE WHITE CONCRETE HAS BECOME BLACK FROM REPEATED DUMPING. YOU CAN ALSO SEE THE MARKS FROM THE DUMPING GOING STRAIGHT INTO THE DRAIN IN THE PARKING LOT. THE EVIDENCE IS THERE PLAIN AS DAY FOR THE PUBLIC TO SEE, HOWEVER THEY CONTINUE TO DO IT.

properties.summary: Incident Type: VESSEL - NRC Report ID: 953485 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: PRIVATE BOAT OWNER
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 953485
Incident Time: 2010-09-06 23:15:00
Nearest City: Williamsburg, VA
Incident Type: VESSEL
Material: GASOLINE: AUTOMOTIVE (UNLEADED)
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: PRIVATE BOAT OWNER
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Sheen Size: 40 feet by 40 feet (area 1600 sq. ft.)
Reported Spill Volume: 10 gallons
Skytruth Minimum Possible Spill Volume: 0.04 gallons
THE FUEL TANK OF A PRIVATE OWNED BOAT IN A BOAT SLIP AT KINGSMILL RESORT LEAKED INTO THE HULL. THE BOAT BILGE PUMP PUMPED THE GASOLINE INTO THE WATER OF THE JAMES RIVER IN THE KINGSMILL MARINA. IT IS ESTIMATED AROUND 8-10 GALLONS ENTERED THE WATER. RESORT STAFF CALLED LOCAL EMERGENCY RESPONSE (FIRE DEPARTMENT) AND THE COAST GUARD. THE FIRE DEPARTMENT RESPONDED AND PLACED BOOMS AROUND THE SPILL AND ABSORBENT SPILL PADS OVER THE AREA OF THE SPILL TO COLLECT. THE PADS WERE COLLECTED AND PLACED IN A SPILL CONTAINER FOR COLLECTION AND DISPOSAL. THE COAST GUARD ARRIVE THE NEXT DAY AND MET WITH THE BOAT OWNER.
